chain.title: The common ingredient
chain.desc: Make Dielectric Paste from the installed recipe. Keep it available for rods, casings, and capacitors so the early generator choices remain inexpensive to build.

chain.title: A casing for each power project
chain.desc: Craft dielectric rods and a casing. Most Powah devices share this base, letting you choose a generator around the resources your base already produces.

chain.title: Burn a simple fuel
chain.desc: Feed a Starter Furnator with an accepted furnace fuel and connect its output. This is one early generator option, not a required step before every other power source.

chain.title: Heat, water, and steady energy
chain.desc: Place a Thermo Generator above a valid heat source and supply water. Check the installed heat-source values and keep the coolant supply running.

chain.title: Keep energy between jobs
chain.desc: Use an Energy Cell to buffer the generator's output. Configure input and output before connecting high-demand machines.

chain.title: Connect source and consumer
chain.desc: Run energy cables between a chosen generator, buffer, and machine. Watch the cable's transfer limit as you move to stronger equipment.

chain.title: A place to transform materials
chain.desc: Place an Energizing Orb with room for nearby rods. Insert only one recipe's ingredients at a time, especially when automating recipe batches.

chain.title: Feed energy into the orb
chain.desc: Power an Energizing Rod within working range of the orb. The rods deliver the energy; the orb itself is the item holder.

chain.title: The first energized alloy
chain.desc: Process iron and gold in the orb to make Energized Steel. Wait for the full recipe energy cost before removing the inputs.

chain.title: Blaze powder into a power material
chain.desc: Energize the recipe's blaze powder into a Blazing Crystal. Better rods and a stronger supply make this faster, but the recipe does not require completing every generator tier.

chain.title: Upgrade the energizing rate
chain.desc: Work through the rod recipes to the Blazing tier. Compare rod throughput with generation and cable limits so the upgrade has a useful energy supply.

chain.title: A diamond with a new job
chain.desc: Energize a diamond into a Niotic Crystal. This is a materials branch; choose the corresponding generators, storage, or rods according to your factory's needs.

chain.title: Invest an emerald and energy
chain.desc: Energize an emerald into a Spirited Crystal. Prepare enough stored energy for the recipe instead of expecting a small generator to finish immediately.

chain.title: Prepare reactor fuel
chain.desc: Mine and process uraninite using an available recipe. The reactor path is an alternative source of power and can develop alongside energizing.

chain.title: Prepare a complete reactor set
chain.desc: Collect the complete set of same-tier reactor blocks needed by the multiblock. Supply its fuel and cooling resources, then verify the reactor forms before relying on its output.

chain.title: Upgrade the reactor branch
chain.desc: Follow the Basic-tier reactor recipes and rebuild a complete matching set. Read the reactor interface to balance fuel, cooling, and output capacity.

chain.title: A core for shared energy
chain.desc: Make an Ender Core in the Energizing Orb. It opens remote-energy devices without requiring a reactor or the highest material tier.

chain.title: Store energy on a shared channel
chain.desc: Configure Ender Cells on the intended channel and add the required storage capacity. Check owner and channel settings at both ends before connecting machines.

chain.title: A large energizing project
chain.desc: Gather the nether star and other Nitro recipe ingredients, then prepare the recipe's substantial energy budget. Use faster rods if needed; the input recipe is the real gate.

chain.title: A buffer for the largest jobs
chain.desc: Follow the cell upgrade recipes to Nitro and configure its sides. Large capacity helps with burst demand, but it does not increase the power your generators create.

chain.title: Grow the thermal-power branch
chain.desc: Follow the Thermo Generator upgrade recipes to Nitro. Keep water and a valid heat source supplied, and upgrade the output cables to match the resulting energy flow.

notes: Re-reviewed 2026-10-07 against local Minecraft 1.20.1 JAR item assets and selected recipes/manuals, with official project sources listed separately. Every authored row now has explicit prerequisites; empty lists identify intentional branch roots. The coverage section states the verified versions and remaining limits. This replaces older list-order and item-count claims.

coverage.scope: Authored branched progression; item and component acquisition objectives, not automatic proof that a factory works.
limits: Targets Powah 5.0.11 for Minecraft 1.20.1. Heat values, costs, and recipe quantities may be changed by the pack.
Intermediate device tiers are described as upgrades rather than padded into one mandatory quest per tier.
Pack scripts, recipe changes, and other Minecraft versions require the installed-pack scan; this guide is not a complete mod manual.
coverage.verification: Local JAR item models and English registry names; selected recipes and bundled manuals checked. Not a new in-game playthrough.
